mock_data.title: Healthy Eating
mock_data.passage:
Most of us would like to live a long and healthy life. Increasingly, doctors are telling us that, in order to do so, we must eat a healthy diet. Too often we ignore the advice.

In most countries of the developed world there is no shortage of food, but their inhabitants could be suffering from a form of malnutrition. This is something that we are accustomed to associate with poor countries which regularly suffer from famine, caused by primitive agricultural methods and over-population.

The problem in the developed countries is that all too many of us are eating too much food which is far from being nutritious and so are lacking in many of the vitamins essential to health. Because of our busy way of life, we rely too much on convenience foods, not taking the time to prepare a nourishing meal for ourselves. Instead, we grab something from the supermarket shelves or freezer and put it in the microwave.

Even when we decide to eat in a restaurant, many of us decide that we have very little time and that our food must be served instantly. It is for this reason that there are, in many countries, so many restaurants that specialize in serving fast food. Unfortunately, much of this food is also junk food, and even more unfortunately many children have become addicted to this, refusing to eat healthier alternatives.

In general, we are eating too much processed food and not enough wholefood. Ideally, we should eat more cereal products in order to increase our intake of fibre, since there is some evidence that this reduces the risk of certain cancers. Antioxidants, these are thought to have some effect in preventing cancer and these are found in significant quantities in fruit and vegetables.

Formerly, it was considered important to eat plenty of eggs and dairy products to remain healthy. Such foods are now known to be high in cholesterol, which can be a contributory factor in heart disease.

Fashions in healthy eating may have changed, but the message remains the same. Watch what you eat!
mock_data.passageB1:
Most people want to live a long and healthy life. Doctors often say that to do this, we need to eat well. But many times, we don't listen to this advice.

In many rich countries, there is a lot of food. But people there can still have bad nutrition. We usually think this only happens in poor countries where people don't have enough food because of farming problems and too many people.

The problem in rich countries is that many people eat too much food that isn't good for you. They don't get enough vitamins, which are important for health. We are often busy, so we eat easy meals. We don't take the time to make a healthy meal. We just buy something from the shop or freezer and heat it up.

Even when we eat at a restaurant, we think we don't have much time. We want our food quickly. That's why there are many fast food restaurants in some countries. But this food is often junk food. Sadly, many children like this food a lot and don't want to eat healthier food.

In general, we eat too much processed food and not enough natural food. It is better to eat more grains like bread or rice. These have fibre, which may help prevent some illnesses. Fruits and vegetables have things called antioxidants. These may also help prevent illnesses.

Before, people thought it was important to eat a lot of eggs and dairy products to be healthy. But now we know these foods have a lot of cholesterol. This can cause heart problems.

Ideas about healthy eating might change, but the main message is the same: Be careful about what you eat!
mock_data.passageB2:
Most people want to live long, healthy lives. Doctors are increasingly emphasizing the importance of a healthy diet in achieving this, but we often disregard their advice.

While food scarcity is a major concern in developing countries, a different form of malnutrition exists in many developed nations. It might seem strange, but despite having plenty of food available, people can still suffer from a lack of essential nutrients.

The problem is that many of us consume too much food that has little nutritional value, leading to a deficiency in vital vitamins and minerals. Our busy lifestyles often lead us to rely on convenience foods. Instead of taking the time to prepare a balanced meal, we often opt for quick options from the supermarket or freezer, ready in minutes in the microwave.

Even when eating out, many people prioritize speed, opting for restaurants that offer immediate service. This demand has led to the proliferation of fast-food restaurants in many countries. Unfortunately, much of this fast food is also junk food, and many children have developed a preference for these unhealthy options, refusing healthier alternatives.

Generally, we consume too much processed food and not enough whole foods. Ideally, we should eat more whole grains to increase our fibre intake, as evidence suggests this may reduce the risk of certain cancers. Antioxidants, believed to help prevent cancer, are found in significant amounts in fruits and vegetables. Prioritizing these is key for a balanced diet.

In the past, eggs and dairy were considered essential for good health. However, we now know that these foods are high in cholesterol, which can contribute to heart disease. This highlights the evolving nature of dietary advice.

While specific dietary recommendations may change over time, the fundamental message remains consistent: be mindful of what you eat! Sustainable and healthy eating habits are key to long-term well-being. It's about finding a balance that works for you and sticking to it.
mock_data.passageC1:
The aspiration to lead a long and healthy life is, arguably, a universal one. Increasingly, medical professionals are underscoring the pivotal role of a judicious dietary regimen in achieving this goal, a recommendation that, regrettably, is often met with indifference.

While food scarcity is rarely an issue in most developed nations, a significant proportion of their populations may, paradoxically, be experiencing a form of micronutrient deficiency. This is a condition typically associated with impoverished countries plagued by famine, the consequences of rudimentary agricultural practices and unsustainable population density.

The crux of the problem in affluent nations lies in the overconsumption of foods that are nutritionally bankrupt, thereby resulting in a deficit of essential vitamins. The pressures of a demanding lifestyle frequently lead to an over-reliance on convenience foods, as individuals forgo the time-consuming process of preparing wholesome, home-cooked meals. Instead, readily available options from supermarket shelves or freezers, often prepared via microwave, become the norm.

Even when dining out, time constraints often dictate choices, leading many to prioritize speed of service above all else. This demand has, in turn, fueled the proliferation of fast-food restaurants in numerous countries. However, much of the fare offered by these establishments is, unfortunately, bereft of nutritional value, and alarmingly, many children have developed a predilection for such options, eschewing healthier alternatives.

Generally speaking, there is an over-dependence on processed foods at the expense of unadulterated, whole foods. Ideally, augmenting our intake of cereal products would enhance our consumption of dietary fibre, given the accumulating evidence suggesting its potential in mitigating the risk of certain cancers. Furthermore, the inclusion of ample fruits and vegetables is vital, as they are rich sources of antioxidants, compounds believed to exert a protective effect against cellular damage and, potentially, cancer. The jury is still out on the full extent of these benefits.

Historically, the consumption of copious amounts of eggs and dairy products was considered essential for maintaining optimal health. However, these foods are now recognized as being high in cholesterol, a factor that can predispose individuals to cardiovascular disease. Caveats abound, however, as moderate consumption may still be acceptable within a balanced diet.

While prevailing attitudes towards healthy eating may have evolved over time, the underlying message remains constant: exercise discernment in your dietary choices! Prudent consumption, coupled with regular physical activity, are the cornerstones of well-being.

mock_data.translation:
Ko'pchiligimiz uzoq va sog'lom hayot kechirishni xohlaymiz. Tobora ko'proq shifokorlar bizga buning uchun sog'lom ovqatlanish kerakligini aytishmoqda. Biz ko'pincha bu maslahatga e'tibor bermaymiz.

Rivojlangan dunyo mamlakatlarining aksariyatida oziq-ovqat tanqisligi yo'q, ammo ularning aholisi to'yib ovqatlanmaslik shaklidan aziyat chekishi mumkin. Biz buni ibtidoiy qishloq xo'jaligi usullari va aholining haddan tashqari ko'payishi sababli muntazam ravishda ocharchilikdan aziyat chekadigan kambag'al mamlakatlar bilan bog'laymiz.

Rivojlangan mamlakatlardagi muammo shundaki, biz juda ko'p ozuqaviy bo'lmagan ovqatlarni iste'mol qilamiz va shuning uchun sog'liq uchun zarur bo'lgan ko'plab vitaminlarga muhtojmiz. Band hayot tarzimiz tufayli biz o'zimiz uchun to'yimli taom tayyorlashga vaqt ajratmasdan, qulay tayyorlangan ovqatlarga haddan tashqari tayanamiz. Buning o'rniga, biz supermarketdan yoki muzlatgichdan biror narsani olib, mikroto'lqinli pechga qo'yamiz.

Hatto restoranda ovqatlanishga qaror qilganimizda ham, ko'pchiligimiz vaqtimiz juda kam deb qaraymiz va ovqat darhol taqdim etilishi kerak deb o'ylaymiz. Shu sababli, ko'plab mamlakatlarda tez tayyorlanadigan ovqatlar xizmatida ixtisoslashgan ko'plab restoranlar mavjud. Afsuski, bu ovqatlarning katta qismi arzimas ovqatdir va yanada afsuski, ko'plab bolalar bunga qaram bo'lib qolgan va sog'lomroq alternativalarni iste'mol qilishdan bosh tortgan.

Umuman olganda, biz juda ko'p qayta ishlangan ovqatlarni va yetarli miqdorda to'laqonli ovqatlarni iste'mol qilmaymiz. Ideal holda, biz tolani iste'mol qilishni oshirish uchun ko'proq don mahsulotlarini iste'mol qilishimiz kerak, chunki ba'zi dalillar shuni ko'rsatadiki, bu ma'lum saraton turlarining xavfini kamaytiradi. Antioksidantlar saraton kasalligining oldini olishda ma'lum ta'sirga ega deb hisoblanadi va ular meva va sabzavotlarda sezilarli miqdorda mavjud.

Ilgari, sog'lom qolish uchun ko'p tuxum va sut mahsulotlarini iste'mol qilish muhim deb hisoblangan. Bunday ovqatlar yurak kasalligiga hissa qo'shadigan omil bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan xolesterinning yuqori darajasiga ega ekanligi ma'lum bo'ldi.

Sog'lom ovqatlanish modasi o'zgargan bo'lishi mumkin, ammo xabar bir xil bo'lib qoladi. Nima yeyayotganingizni kuzating!

judicious dietary regimen.exampleUzbek: Qandli diabetni boshqarish uchun oqilona ovqatlanish rejimiga rioya qilish juda muhim.

unsustainable population density.exampleUzbek: Barqaror bo'lmagan aholi zichligi resurslarni zo'riqtirishi va atrof-muhitning buzilishiga olib kelishi mumkin.

mock_data.translationB1:
Ko'pchilik uzoq va sog'lom hayot kechirishni xohlaydi. Shifokorlar ko'pincha bunga erishish uchun yaxshi ovqatlanish kerakligini aytishadi. Lekin ko'p hollarda biz bu maslahatga quloq solmaymiz.

Ko'plab boy mamlakatlarda oziq-ovqat mahsulotlari ko'p. Ammo o'sha yerda ham odamlarda noto'g'ri ovqatlanish kuzatilishi mumkin. Biz odatda bu faqat kambag'al mamlakatlarda, odamlarda dehqonchilik muammolari va aholi sonining ko'pligi tufayli yetarli oziq-ovqat bo'lmaganda sodir bo'ladi, deb o'ylaymiz.

Boy mamlakatlardagi muammo shundaki, ko'pchilik siz uchun foydali bo'lmagan juda ko'p ovqat yeydi. Ular sog'liq uchun muhim bo'lgan yetarli miqdorda vitaminlar olishmaydi. Biz ko'pincha band bo'lamiz, shuning uchun oson taomlar yeymiz. Biz sog'lom taom tayyorlashga vaqt ajratmaymiz. Biz shunchaki do'kondan yoki muzlatgichdan biror narsa sotib olib, uni isitamiz.

Hatto restoranda ovqatlanganimizda ham, bizda ko'p vaqt yo'q deb o'ylaymiz. Biz ovqatimizni tezda olishni xohlaymiz. Shuning uchun ba'zi mamlakatlarda tez ovqatlanish restoranlari ko'p. Lekin bu ovqat ko'pincha keraksiz ovqat bo'ladi. Afsuski, ko'p bolalar bu ovqatni juda yaxshi ko'rishadi va sog'lomroq ovqat yeyishni xohlamaydilar.

Umuman olganda, biz juda ko'p qayta ishlangan ovqat va yetarli miqdorda tabiiy ovqat yemaymiz. Ko'proq non yoki guruch kabi don mahsulotlarini iste'mol qilish yaxshiroqdir. Bularning tarkibida kletchatka mavjud bo'lib, u ba'zi kasalliklarning oldini olishga yordam berishi mumkin. Meva va sabzavotlar tarkibida antioksidantlar deb ataladigan moddalar mavjud. Bular ham kasalliklarning oldini olishga yordam berishi mumkin.

Ilgari, odamlar sog'lom bo'lish uchun ko'p tuxum va sut mahsulotlarini iste'mol qilish muhim deb o'ylashgan. Ammo endi biz bu ovqatlarda ko'p miqdorda xolesterin borligini bilamiz. Bu yurak xastaliklariga olib kelishi mumkin.

Sog'lom ovqatlanish haqidagi fikrlar o'zgarishi mumkin, ammo asosiy xabar bir xil: Nima yeyayotganingizga ehtiyot bo'ling!
mock_data.translationB2:
Ko'pchilik uzoq va sog'lom hayot kechirishni xohlaydi. Shifokorlar bunga erishishda sog'lom ovqatlanishning ahamiyatini tobora ko'proq ta'kidlamoqda, ammo biz ko'pincha ularning maslahatlariga e'tibor bermaymiz.

Rivojlanayotgan mamlakatlarda oziq-ovqat tanqisligi asosiy muammo bo'lsa, rivojlangan davlatlarda noto'g'ri ovqatlanishning boshqa shakli mavjud. G'alati tuyulishi mumkin, ammo oziq-ovqat mahsulotlari ko'p bo'lishiga qaramay, odamlar hali ham muhim oziq moddalar etishmasligidan aziyat chekishi mumkin.

Muammo shundaki, ko'pchiligimiz ozuqaviy qiymati kam bo'lgan juda ko'p ovqat iste'mol qilamiz, bu esa muhim vitaminlar va minerallar etishmovchiligiga olib keladi. Bizning band hayotimiz ko'pincha bizni qulay ovqatlarga tayanishga majbur qiladi. Muvozanatli taom tayyorlashga vaqt ajratish o'rniga, biz ko'pincha supermarket yoki muzlatgichdan tezda tayyor bo'ladigan, mikroto'lqinli pechda bir necha daqiqada pishadigan variantlarni tanlaymiz.

Hatto tashqarida ovqatlanayotganda ham, ko'pchilik tezlikni birinchi o'ringa qo'yib, tezkor xizmat ko'rsatadigan restoranlarni tanlaydi. Bu talab ko'plab mamlakatlarda tez ovqatlanish restoranlarining ko'payishiga olib keldi. Afsuski, bu tez ovqatlanishning ko'pchiligi ham keraksiz ovqat hisoblanadi va ko'plab bolalar sog'lomroq muqobillardan voz kechib, ushbu zararli variantlarga ustunlik berishni boshladilar.

Odatda, biz juda ko'p qayta ishlangan ovqat va etarli darajada to'liq (tabiiy) ovqat iste'mol qilmaymiz. Ideal holda, biz tolali ovqatlanishni ko'paytirish uchun ko'proq to'liq donli mahsulotlar iste'mol qilishimiz kerak, chunki dalillar shuni ko'rsatadiki, bu ba'zi saraton kasalliklari xavfini kamaytirishi mumkin. Saraton kasalligining oldini olishga yordam beradi deb hisoblangan antioksidantlar meva va sabzavotlarda sezilarli miqdorda mavjud. Bularga ustunlik berish muvozanatli ovqatlanish uchun juda muhim.

Ilgari tuxum va sut mahsulotlari yaxshi sog'liq uchun zarur deb hisoblangan. Biroq, endi biz bu mahsulotlar xolesteringa boy ekanligini bilamiz, bu esa yurak kasalliklariga hissa qo'shishi mumkin. Bu ovqatlanish bo'yicha maslahatlarning o'zgaruvchan tabiatini ta'kidlaydi.

Muayyan ovqatlanish bo'yicha tavsiyalar vaqt o'tishi bilan o'zgarishi mumkin bo'lsa-da, asosiy xabar o'zgarmaydi: nima yeyayotganingizga e'tiborli bo'ling! Barqaror va sog'lom ovqatlanish odatlari uzoq muddatli farovonlikning kalitidir. Gap siz uchun mos keladigan muvozanatni topish va unga rioya qilish haqida ketmoqda.
mock_data.translationC1:
Uzoq va sog'lom hayot kechirishga intilish, ehtimol, universal istakdir. Tibbiyot mutaxassislari tobora ko'proq bu maqsadga erishishda o'ylangan ratsionning muhim rolini ta'kidlamoqda, afsuski, bu tavsiya ko'pincha befarqlik bilan qabul qilinadi.

Ko'pgina rivojlangan davlatlarda oziq-ovqat tanqisligi muammo bo'lmasa-da, ularning aholisining sezilarli qismi, paradoksal tarzda, mikronutriyentlar yetishmovchiligini boshdan kechirayotgan bo'lishi mumkin. Bu odatda ibtidoiy qishloq xo'jaligi amaliyotlari va barqaror bo'lmagan aholi zichligi oqibatida ocharchilikdan aziyat chekayotgan kambag'al mamlakatlar bilan bog'liq holatdir.

Boy davlatlardagi muammoning mohiyati oziqlantiruvchi qiymatga ega bo'lmagan oziq-ovqatlarni haddan tashqari ko'p iste'mol qilishda yotadi, bu esa zarur vitaminlar tanqisligiga olib keladi. Talabchan turmush tarzi bosimi ko'pincha tayyor oziq-ovqatlarga haddan tashqari bog'liqlikka olib keladi, chunki odamlar foydali, uyda tayyorlangan ovqatlarni tayyorlash uchun vaqt ajratmaydi. Buning o'rniga, supermarket javonlaridan yoki muzlatgichlardan osongina topiladigan, ko'pincha mikroto'lqinli pechda tayyorlangan variantlar norma bo'lib qoladi.

Hatto ovqatlanish uchun tashqariga chiqqanda ham, vaqt cheklovlari ko'pincha tanlovlarni belgilaydi va ko'pchilik xizmat ko'rsatish tezligini hamma narsadan ustun qo'yadi. Bu talab, o'z navbatida, ko'plab mamlakatlarda tez ovqatlanish restoranlarining ko'payishiga olib keldi. Biroq, ushbu muassasalar tomonidan taklif etilayotgan ko'plab taomlar, afsuski, oziqlantiruvchi qiymatga ega emas va tashvishlanarlisi shundaki, ko'plab bolalar bunday variantlarga moyillikni rivojlantirgan, sog'lomroq alternativalarni rad etmoqda.

Umuman olganda, buzilmagan, to'liq oziq-ovqatlar hisobiga qayta ishlangan oziq-ovqatlarga haddan tashqari bog'liqlik mavjud. Ideal holda, don mahsulotlarini iste'mol qilishni ko'paytirish bizning xun tolasi iste'molini oshiradi, chunki uning ba'zi saraton kasalliklari xavfini kamaytirishdagi potentsiali haqida dalillar to'planmoqda. Bundan tashqari, ko'p miqdorda meva va sabzavotlarni iste'mol qilish juda muhim, chunki ular antioksidantlarning boy manbai bo'lib, hujayra shikastlanishiga va, ehtimol, saratonga qarshi himoya ta'sirini ko'rsatadi deb ishoniladi. Bu foydalarning to'liq miqdori bo'yicha yakuniy xulosa yo'q.

Tarixan, ko'p miqdorda tuxum va sut mahsulotlarini iste'mol qilish optimal salomatlikni saqlash uchun zarur deb hisoblangan. Biroq, bu oziq-ovqatlar endi xolesteringa boyligi bilan tan olingan, bu omil odamlarni yurak-qon tomir kasalliklariga moyil qilishi mumkin. Biroq, ogohlantirishlar juda ko'p, chunki me'yorida iste'mol qilish muvozanatli ovqatlanish doirasida hali ham maqbul bo'lishi mumkin.

Sog'lom ovqatlanishga nisbatan mavjud munosabatlar vaqt o'tishi bilan o'zgarib turishi mumkin bo'lsa-da, asosiy xabar o'zgarmas bo'lib qolmoqda: ovqatlanish tanlovingizda farosatli bo'ling! Ehtiyotkorona iste'mol qilish, muntazam jismoniy faollik bilan birgalikda, farovonlikning asosidir.
